correctness.reason: The Palm one- and two-point void formulas, an integrable second-moment envelope, horoball intersection asymptotics, and dominated convergence establish the L2 limit.

originality.reason: The primary ideal-Poisson-Voronoi paper leaves the finer typical-cell variance scale open and does not state this L2 concentration.
residual_risks: A specialized stochastic-geometry source could contain the same second-moment limit under different Palm notation.

scientific_value.reason: The result gives a natural low-intensity concentration theorem and excludes a full candidate variance scale without claiming the finer open asymptotics.
